notes: THE TOWER model sheet (Rivals project; the set's one big captain, shared with SOLO v2 as defender D, who is drawn on this body with SOLO's own tone-for-tone kit swap): RIVAL_KIT white shirt (plain, no number) with teal collar/sleeve trims, CAPTAIN'S ARMBAND on his LEFT upper arm (front: screen-right sleeve; back: screen-left; side facing east: the far arm), black gloves, grey shorts with white side stripes, white socks, teal boots; buzz cut, heavy brow, square jaw; the same 98 px height as No.10 (crown row 5, soles row 102) at ~1.3x bulk (front shoulders ~64 px across the sleeves). Arm as drawn (the authority for any Tower frame): side shoulder top row 33 -> glove end row 75 (43 rows), front/back collar row 33 -> glove end row 72 (39). One frame per view, each carrying its own "view": frame "Side" (east; contact (74,102) = the boot toe column on row 102), frame "Front" and frame "Back" (contact (64,102) = body centre between the boots, contactL / contactR = the outer row-102 sole pixels, soleL / soleR = the sole centres). pelvis = hip point (measured: side the centre of the shorts row 64, front/back (64,64) as No.10's Idle); head = skull centre (measured: centre of the head rows 5-28). No number anywhere, so a runtime flip is legal without a west strip. Points are pixel indices (studioAnim adds 0.5; contact lands on the bottom edge of row 102). bbox = [x0,y0,x1,y1] measured on the art. Reference / model sheet (TF3 is built on Front, TC1 on Back; SOLO v2 RivalFront RF1T-RF4T on Front; the field draws him 1.3x wide). Palette: the Rivals 17 colours (RIVAL_KIT). Studio layer: Art only. Studio: Rivals / TowerIdle / Side, Front, Back (frame 1 each).
